1581.title: The Holiday
1581.overview: Two women, one American and one British, swap homes at Christmastime following bad breakups. Each woman finds romance with a local man but realizes that the imminent return home may end the relationship.

11053.title: Flatfoot in Hong Kong
11053.overview: Inspector Rizzo is accused of drug trafficking. In order to clear his name he has to find out who is the person, from a Mafia ring, who has infiltrated his police department.

37933.title: Tales from Earthsea
37933.overview: As crops dwindle and dragons reappear, mankind stands on the verge of total chaos. Lord Archmage Sparrowhawk, a powerful wizard, and Arren, a troubled young prince, search for the force behind this mysterious imbalance that threatens to destroy the land of Earthsea.

314029.title: Neon Bull
314029.overview: Iremar works at the rodeo in North East of Brazil. From his home, the truck he uses to transport the animals, he dreams of a future in the region's booming clothing industry.

548845.title: To Kill a Nazi
548845.overview: A documentary feature by award-winning filmmaker Boaz Dvir, “To Kill a Nazi” tells the story of a French family man who sets out in to kill his father’s Gestapo executioner and ended up playing a pivotal role in history’s most audacious hostage rescue.
548845.trailerName: To Kill A Nazi trailer | SVJFF

680493.title: Return to Silent Hill
680493.overview: When James receives a mysterious letter from his lost love Mary, he is drawn to Silent Hill—a once-familiar town now consumed by darkness. As he searches for her, James faces monstrous creatures and unravels a terrifying truth that will push him to the edge of his sanity.

773549.title: Grow
773549.overview: After his girlfriend dies, a grieving man awakens impossibly pregnant and becomes the captive of her fanatical family, who will stop at nothing to see the child born.

858477.title: Last Night I Conquered the City of Thebes
858477.overview: On a cold winter afternoon, António and Jota return from the front with their friends, looking for an ancient Roman thermal bath. They joke with each other while wading through swamps, recounting past tactical glories. The baths have appeared after a long time spent under the water of a reservoir, and people of all ages curious about the discovery come to spend the day. But there is something mysterious about these thermal waters - as if the baths influence the mood of the men, giving them the courage to say things they have never told anyone. As day turns to night, they confess their feelings and their fears of losing their best friend forever.

863149.title: Heartman: Rock and Love
863149.overview: Once known as the frontman of the rock band Ambulance during his college days, Seung-min now lives a quiet life running a small instrument shop. One day, his legendary first love Bo-na, the girl he never even had the courage to confess to before she suddenly disappeared, unexpectedly reappears in his life. From that moment on, Seung-min's heart begins to race again. But as old feelings resurface, he finds himself trapped in an awkward predicament: a secret he must never let his first love discover… no matter what.
863149.trailerName: Heartman: Rock and Love | Official Teaser Trailer | INTL

970029.title: N'Diongane
970029.overview: A hunter dies in a lion's jaws and leaves a wife and two children. The elder child, who is now the only man around the house, is called the little husband. Because of this nickname, he becomes the laughingstock of all the children in the village. Desperate, the child runs away and drowns in the sea. His mother and sister will follow the same fate. The film is based on a story by Birago Diop.

1025389.title: Strange River
1025389.overview: One summer, Dídac travels by bike along the Danube with his family, starting where the river first emerges in Germany. As they journey downstream, he begins seeing a mysterious boy, Alexander, who appears and disappears in the water. Dídac feels himself changing, drawn toward Alexander and away from his brother Biel. Their mother, Monika, who once took the same trip as a teenager, drifts into memories of a past summer love. When she sees Dídac and Alexander together, she encourages them to continue the journey alone. But as twilight falls, Dídac begins to question who Alexander truly is.

1061805.title: Lascars 2: Family Business
1061805.overview: 10 years after their adventures, our heroes leave Boningville for the hood of Marseilles. Their goal: find Tony’s mother’s who would keep with her an old legacy that would make a killing ! With Joe's who is about to become a dad and Tony still struggling, the mission is about to go off course.

1157869.title: Parallel Tales
1157869.overview: In search of inspiration for her new novel, Sylvie spies on her neighbors in the building across the street using a telescope. When she hires young Adam to help her with her daily routine, she has no idea that he will turn her life and her work upside down, until the fiction she had imagined surpasses the reality of them all.

1184941.title: Blue Heron
1184941.overview: A family of six's fresh start on 1990s Vancouver Island unravels as their youngest child, Sasha, witnesses the increasingly dangerous behavior of her older brother, Jeremy.

1195309.title: Feast or Famine
1195309.overview: A documentary following the London restaurant Angelina, its chefs and owners, over the span of three months, as they strive to achieve their ultimate goal of winning their first Michelin star.

1212461.title: OBEX
1212461.overview: Conor Marsh lives a secluded life with his dog, Sandy, until one day he begins playing OBEX, a new, state-of-the-art computer game. When Sandy goes missing, the line between reality and game blurs and Conor must venture into the strange world of OBEX to bring her home.

1246509.title: Tear Gas
1246509.overview: 16-year-old Elene and her war-scarred family are drawn into a mass protest in Tbilisi that transforms the streets into a battleground for freedom, forcing them to confront the fractures already threatening to tear them apart.

1294189.title: The Mongoose
1294189.overview: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

1301421.title: The Sheep Detectives
1301421.overview: George Hardy is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

1307373.title: Wasteman
1307373.overview: Taylor's hopes for a fresh start post-parole are jeopardised by cellmate Dee's arrival. As Dee takes Taylor under his wing, a vicious attack tests their bond, forcing Taylor to choose between protecting Dee and his own chances at freedom.

1310573.title: Barrio Triste
1310573.overview: On the outskirts of Medellín, Colombia in the late 1980s, local residents report strange lights descending from the sky. When a reporter arrives to investigate, a ragtag group of teens from a lawless neighbourhood storm the scene and steal his camera. In the hands of its new owners, the device records a mesmerising plunge into their frantic existence.

1318829.title: Fantasy
1318829.overview: Mihrije, Sina, and Jasna are best friends in their early twenties who live in Slovenia. They are tomboys and refuse to conform to the conservative system they live in. Their world turns upside down when they meet Fantasy, a transgender woman. Together, they embark on a journey that explores the complexities of gender, desire, and self-discovery.

1355885.title: From Inside Out - The Architecture of Peter Zumthor
1355885.overview: We all come from houses in which we live, dream, love and die. This long-term documentary project explores the significance of architecture in our everyday lives and takes its audience on a journey to the most impressive places designed by Swiss architect Peter Zumthor.

1391021.title: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
1391021.overview: Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to work as a chef in a Chinese restaurant to pay off family debts, where he meets floor manager Ma Junsheng. Their Dragon Restaurant rises to fame, attracting crowds with authentic‑tasting Chinese food. But war breaks out, and local conditions take a drastic turn for the worse. No one can remain unaffected. What lies ahead for them? And how will the Dragon Restaurant hold on amid the war?

1397485.title: Girls Like Girls
1397485.overview: After her mother's passing, 17-year-old Coley navigates new feelings of intimacy with Sonya in rural Oregon, where both girls must overcome their mutual uncertainties and self-doubt to embrace their connection.

1408493.title: The Turkish Coffee Table
1408493.overview: When Zehra and İbrahim, a couple adjusting to new parenthood, argue over a coffee table, it seems like a harmless domestic spat. Wanting to assert himself for once, İbrahim insists on buying it. But when he’s left alone to assemble it, he makes a single irreversible mistake — and begins spiraling into a pit of lies, panic, and performative calm as he tries to hide the truth from the people he loves the most.
1408493.trailerName: Glass Coffee Table | Trailer | In Cinemas February 20th

1409645.title: La petite mort
1409645.overview: La petite mort is a personal experiment balancing between film, theater and documentary. Inspired by the character of Ophelia, this story of friendship, memory, and coming of age navigates the archives of childhood and the experiences of girls growing up in a small Polish town in the early 21st century.

1419053.title: ChaO
1419053.overview: In a futuristic world where humans and mermaids coexist, the life of mild-mannered office worker Stephan is upended when he is suddenly proposed to by Chao — a princess from the mermaid kingdom. With no time to make sense of what's happening, Stephan soon finds himself living with the unpredictable, wholehearted Chao, and her sincere love begins to break down his emotional barriers.

1425837.title: Sua's Home
1425837.overview: 15-year-old Young-sun, abandoned by her adoptive parents and left with nowhere to go, temporarily stays at the home of Sua, whom she met as a tennis training partner. Young-sun, wanting to stay at Sua's house for a long time, tries hard to become part of the family, but Sua and her family find Young-sun burdensome.

1442669.title: La Vénus électrique
1442669.overview: Artist Antoine has lost all inspiration and slipped into alcoholism since the death of his wife Irène, a loss he blames himself for. Suzanne is a penniless sideshow performer pretending to be a clairvoyant, whom Antoine consults in a bid to connect with Irène. Antoine’s dealer Armand, desperate to keep Antoine from falling apart, urges Suzanne to keep the ruse alive. She stages a series of improvised hypnosis sessions, claiming she can channel Irène in exchange for having her debts paid by Armand.
1442669.trailerName: The Electric Kiss / La Vénus électrique (2026) - Trailer (English Subs)

1447853.title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
1447853.overview: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.
1447853.original_title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger

1449709.title: Agata Christian - Murder on the Snow
1449709.overview: Christian Agata, a famous criminologist known for his biting sarcasm and infallible investigative talent, finds himself caught up in a weekend of mystery. Invited by the Gulmar family—tycoons of the board game industry—to act as a spokesperson for the relaunch of their historic game "Crime Castle," he agrees to spend a few days at their winter estate in the Aosta Valley. What began as a quiet commercial operation soon transforms itslef into a case to solve.

1451117.title: Weightless
1451117.overview: Fifteen-year-old Lea is spending her summer at a health camp tucked between the forest and the sea. Her new roommate, Sasha, is everything Lea wishes she could be: bold, magnetic, and unafraid to take up space in the world. While Sasha flirts with the local boys, Lea’s gaze is fixed on Rune, the camp’s charming instructor. When Rune reciprocates her attention, something awakens within Lea; an unfamiliar yet thrilling desire.

1455661.title: For the Opponents
1455661.overview: In the tough neighborhood of Tepito, a boy faces the great Mexican dream: becoming a boxing champion.

1469229.title: The Djinn's Curse 2
1469229.overview: In a village at the foot of Mount Budo, Diana begins behaving violently after disappearing into the forest, forcing her husband Anas to kill her.

1471533.title: Ruslan and Lyudmila
1471533.overview: The young knight Ruslan stands up for Lyudmila and spoils the plans of her father, Prince Vladimir, to marry her daughter to one of the worthy fellows – Ragday, Ratmir or Farlaf. Lyudmila falls in love with Ruslan, he is also fascinated by the beauty, but their happiness will not happen: Vladimir is against it, and then Lyudmila is completely kidnapped by the envious sorcerer Chernomor, eager to avenge the prince for past insults.

1472813.title: The Diary of a Chambermaid
1472813.overview: Gianina, a young Romanian, works as a housekeeper for a bourgeois family in Bordeaux. In the evenings, she rehearses the role of a maid with an amateur theater troupe in an adaptation of The Diary of a Chambermaid by Octave Mirbeau. She takes care of Louen, her employers’ son, while her own daughter is growing up far from her, in Romania. The maternal absence deepens into a wound but, as Christmas approaches, the promise of a reunion begins to take shape.
1472813.original_title: Le Journal d'une femme de chambre

1474861.title: Harusnya Horror
1474861.overview: For the sake of being able to watch the last episode of his favorite anime that appeared exactly before his sudden death, a shy anime-obsessed ghost is forced to accept a task from the afterlife to haunt 100 thousand humans. The problem? He's more terrified of people than they are of him. So, to achieve his goal, he reluctantly becomes the "star talent" for a crew of broke, fraudulent horror creators, which in the end forces him to choose between his personal ambition or saving the only 'family' he has ever found.
1474861.trailerName: Reza Arap Dimanfaatkan! Official Trailer Harusnya Horor

1478893.title: You’ve Got Mail
1478893.overview: A mail deliverer is captured by Irish-American gangsters to launder money and drugs for them in this black comedy thriller.

1481197.title: The Bog
1481197.overview: A boy's body is discovered in a peat field, and a local drunk confesses to a decades-old murder. Policeman Broze reopens the case and is forced to confront his own role in the tragic game played by boys 30 years ago—a day he can't remember or forget.

1485357.title: Project Eggman
1485357.overview: The untold backstory of one of gaming's greatest villains, Doctor Eggman

1492013.title: They Come Out of Margo
1492013.overview: All fears, anxieties and hopes are embodied in the character of Margo, a songwriter who was once famous but who now isolates herself in her apartment. A party held to celebrate her 40th birthday and the emotions that are born there unexpectedly help Margo enter a new stage in her life.

1492461.title: Chrysalis
1492461.overview: In war-torn 1970s Vietnam, a resourceful young boy navigates his place in a chaotic world, guided by his grandmother’s wisdom while haunted by memories of his fractured family.
1492461.original_title: Mãi Nợ Một Lời Tạm Biệt

1497325.title: Mockbuster
1497325.overview: A struggling filmmaker’s opportunity collides with chaos and compromise when Sharknado’s notorious studio, The Asylum, invites him to direct a "mockbuster."

1509997.title: The Showdown
1509997.overview: A young man is confronted by a vicious supernatural entity whilst attempting to retrieve some belongings from his ex-boyfriend.

1513133.title: 28 Hours Later
1513133.overview: 28 hours after the Rage virus began to spread a group of young people begin to travel to a new safe space

1513261.title: Dante
1513261.overview: Responding to an emergency call, a young paramedic unwittingly finds himself thrust into the middle of a war between two crime lords, triggering an escalating series of gruesome twists and turns over the course of one crazy night.

1513581.title: Plötzlich Schwester
1513581.overview: Two sisters who couldn't be more different are unaware of their father's double life with two families and the existence of the other until his sudden death. While stuffy Sandra has no need for such a relationship, chaotic Sandy never leaves her new-found sister's side.

1520109.title: Es frisst
1520109.overview: After a botched robbery, a young gangster couple takes a mother and her daughter hostage and ends up in a forgotten forest cemetery on the edge of a disused industrial estate.

1520685.title: Until We Talk
1520685.overview: Rami's 13-year-old daughter is killed in Jerusalem by a suicide bomber. When the grieving father meets Palestinian Bassam, an unlikely friendship develops between the two fathers. They do not yet know what tragic twist of fate will bring them even closer together.

1520813.title: Wanted
1520813.overview: Hyun-jun, an ordinary postman, is mistakenly arrested as a wanted criminal due to his identical appearance to fugitive Choi Cheol-gu. While struggling to prove his innocence, the real Cheol-gu escapes prison and flees to Taiwan. When Hyun-jun travels there on a reward trip, he is once again mistaken for the criminal and even kidnapped, only to be rescued by tough detective Woo-hee and her partner. As repeated mix-ups lead to comedic chaos, Hyun-jun and Woo-hee grow closer and ultimately team up to catch the real fugitive together.

1533549.title: Wicked of Oz
1533549.overview: A freak tornado pulls Dorothy Gale into the wicked world of Oz just in time for the down-on-her-luck Kansas farm girl to confront Glinda, a starving cannibal who finds herself all out of Munchkin meat. Things go downhill from there, as Dorothy goes head-to-head (literally) against a skull-cracking Scarecrow, a Tin Man whose hobby is to collect still-beating hearts and a Cowardly Lion who pleases his master by ripping apart anyone he sees. Oz becomes Ooze as Dorothy – armed with scavenged weapons – battles her way through hordes of psychotic enemies until she finally happens upon her ultimate nemesis, the Wicked of Oz.
1533549.trailerName: WICKED OF OZ | ACTION | FANTASY | TRAILER | 2025 | INSURGENCE

1534061.title: The Young People
1534061.overview: Centers on a couple of school friends, one of whom starts to develop red flag behavior.

1536429.title: Somewhere Between Sleep
1536429.overview: Anke is about to leave her small German town in the Black Forest region, while Lisa finds it hard to feel at home there. They meet by chance on a cold, grey autumn day, and wander the streets together. Cracks in the thin membrane between reality and dream transform their stroll into a journey to new places.

1538861.title: Emperor Vs. Sarat Chandra
1538861.trailerName: Emperor Vs Sarat Chandra | Teaser | Nandy Movies | Srijit Mukherji | Abir, Tota, Mimi | Pujo 2026

1543469.title: Heartland
1543469.overview: A former country star, Misty Jones, comes out of seclusion to investigate the disappearance of her missing niece, a rising country musician and must grapple with her own past and Nashville’s seedy underbelly. Her search uncovers a murky side of Nashville where no one, including Misty, is who they seem.

1549421.title: Where do I go from here?
1549421.overview: Majd and Shahfaisal live together in a residential group for unaccompanied refugee minors in Germany. Here, in the protected environment of the group, for the first time after fleeing, they should be able to live a life true to who they really are: teenagers who are just developing a personality, have dreams and are looking for their place in society. But how is this supposed to work if they are not even part of this society due to their refugee status?

1551021.title: Hellboy: Devastation
1551021.overview: B.P.R.D. sends Hellboy on a mission to save a woman kidnapped by Beleth and his legions of demons.
1551021.trailerName: FIRST TEASER - HELLBOY: DEVASTATION - COMING 2026 TO U.W.P. TV

1552493.title: Khadam
1552493.overview: Melor, who is forced to inherit her family's inheritance. As a result, she must race against time to save her daughter from a dark entity that is beginning to take over her life.
1552493.trailerName: Khadam | Official Trailer | Akan Datang Di Pawagam GSC pada 2026

1567149.title: Kamen Rider Kabuto 20th: ​​The One Who Inherits the Heavens
1567149.overview: 20 years after the events of the series, humans and Worms are walking towards the path of coexistence. However, ZECT is secretly developing a new Masked Rider System. Yui Kagami, the son of Arata Kagami/Kamen Rider Gatack is qualified to use the new system. Arata Kagami also investigates a ZECT conspiracy all by himself, but a shadow of an unexpected person appears before him...!
1567149.trailerName: Kamen Rider Kabuto 20th Anniversary: The One Who Inherits the Heavens - 60-Second Teaser
1567149.original_title: 仮面ライダーカブト20th 天を継ぐもの

1570733.title: Vampyr
1570733.overview: A struggling author, who is obsessed with Edvard Munch, finds himself on the verge of madness when he's dragged into a dangerous murder mystery that uncovers a horrifying truth about the world-famous painter, and potentially rewrites history as we know it.

1570925.title: Vita mia
1570925.overview: Didi, a Hungarian noblewoman who survived war and communism, has lived in Salento for years, cared for by Vita, a young woman from Puglia. She spends her final days amidst memories, guilt, and friendship, searching for peace.

1583853.title: Se domani non torno
1583853.overview: It follows the tragic life of Giulia Cecchettin, starting from the private pain of her father, Gino Cecchettin, and culminating in a cinematic story that stems from the book of the victim's father, entitled Dear Giulia.

1588205.title: Without Looking Back
1588205.overview: A story about friendship and a crime that never happened. The main characters are Sonya and Zhenya. One day, they push a guy who was bothering them to the ground and, thinking they've killed him, go on the run.

ads.name: Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads

1598189.title: CHAITANYA
1598189.overview: The story of Chaitanya, the mystic saint who transformed devotion into a revolution.  The great king Prataparudra learns that God Himself is secretly present in his kingdom. He tries to meet with Him, but he must pass through insurmountable trials to earn His favor.
1598189.trailerName: CHAITANYA Movie | Official Trailer | Epic Historical Drama of Divine Love

1599277.title: Cyclone
1599277.overview: A transgender woman from mainland China travels to Hong Kong with a single, urgent goal: to undergo gender-affirming surgery. Moving through the city in a state of emotional suspension, she navigates temporary lodging, medical bureaucracy, and fleeting encounters with strangers who alternately offer intimacy, indifference, or quiet solidarity. As the date of the operation approaches, her journey becomes less about the procedure itself than about the weight of expectation, fear, and self-recognition.

1601709.title: Bapakmu Kiper
1601709.overview: The story follows an 18-year-old named Ronaldhino Sujatmiko—known as Dino—who harbors anger toward his father, Warto. Warto is a former local soccer star and soccer gambler whom Dino believes is responsible for his mother’s death. Dino’s chance to leave his village comes through the Tarkam Super Cup, a soccer talent search tournament.  The conflict comes to a head when Dino’s main team is taken over by another party just before the final. This situation forces his father, Warto, to step in and form a new team made up of veteran players, despite all the limitations they face.
1601709.trailerName: Official Trailer - Bapakmu Kiper - Tayang 3 September 2026

1609709.title: Amy Winehouse: The Tragic Downfall
1609709.overview: A documentary that delves into the life, career, and struggles of iconic British singer and songwriter Amy Winehouse. Through the archival footage, interviews with those who knew her and expert analysis, the film explores Amy's quick rise to fame, her battles with addiction and mental health issues, and the pressure of celebrity culture. It offers a poignant reflection on the music industry's impact on artists and devastating consequences of unchecked fame.

1610413.title: One Last Adventure: The Making of Stranger Things 5
1610413.overview: An inside look at the years of effort and craft that went into the final installment of the Duffer Brothers' generation-defining series.

1613037.title: Buzzkill
1613037.overview: A group of sorority sisters end up trapped with a murderer. Nora’s tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she’s drunk.

1614061.title: Bagong Tukso
1614061.overview: Meet the freshest faces of VMX! Apphle Celso, Margaret Diaz, Heart Fox, and Allison Ross turn up the heat, bare fantasies, and tease you into an unforgettable sexy experience.
1614061.trailerName: BAGONG TUKSO OFFICIAL TRAILER | Margaret Diaz, Apphle Celso, Allison Ross, and Heart Fox

1614701.title: River Dreams
1614701.overview: Young women imagine themselves as a river: what starts off as a poetic metaphor is linked to images of landscape and becomes a many-voiced narration, radically morphing into a political statement. The Kazakh woman, she prefers life without man.

1616237.title: Arulvaan
1616237.overview: Follows Muthuvel, a resolute collector who overcomes all obstacles to educate a tribal girl and provide school access for the entire forest community.

1616493.title: Premature
1616493.overview: After an impulsive one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, two flatmates must confront who they are, and who they want to be, before the baby arrives.
1616493.trailerName: PREMATURE | Official Trailer | Scottish Romantic Comedy Feature Film

1616685.title: He Calls Me Daughter
1616685.overview: An exploration of women shaped by absent or broken fathers as they find healing, courage, and restored identity through God’s faithful love. Through raw and powerful stories, HE CALLS ME DAUGHTER reveals a timeless truth: A heavenly Father changes everything.
1616685.trailerName: He Calls Me Daughter | OFFICIAL TEASER TRAILER

1617133.title: Solitaire
1617133.overview: A young woman adjusts to life in a new city, managing remote work, a relationship on thin ice, and single-player tennis.

1620269.title: looksMAXXING
1620269.overview: When a dopamine-depleted young man joins an online forum promising a better life through physical perfection, he descends on a destructive path.

1620525.title: The Canary's Lullaby
1620525.overview: In a small village devastated by a past storm, an elderly woman named Tae lives alone selling grilled dumplings. Her life follows a quiet, repetitive routine, as if time itself has come to a standstill. One night, Tae discovers a strange creature in the mountains and brings it home, naming it Haru. Haru eats only the dumplings Tae makes by hand. Awkward yet gentle, Haru’s presence gives Tae a renewed sense of purpose. However, the village cannot accept what it does not understand. Rumors of a monster called “UWAN” spread, and fear takes hold. Haru is branded a harbinger of disaster, while Tae is deemed mentally unstable and forcibly hospitalized. Caught between rigid institutions and superstition, Tae struggles to protect Haru. Finally, she stages a grand fake funeral, allowing Haru to escape the village’s fear. As another storm approaches, Tae realizes that love is not about possession, but about letting go.

1625517.title: HOMELESS
1625517.overview: HOMELESS is a documentary that humanizes unhoused people and explores their backgrounds, dreams and struggles to find the way home. The film aims to raise awareness and funds to end homelessness, which is an ever more urgent global challenge: The United Nations Human Settlements Program estimates that 1.6 billion people live in inadequate housing, and the best available data suggests that more than 100 million people have no housing at all.

1625901.title: The Dating App Killer: The Monica White Story
1625901.overview: A divorcee reenters the dating pool by creating an online profile, but when her match displays unsettling behavior and a series of women from the same dating site go missing, she must save herself from becoming the next victim.

flatrate.name: Lifetime Movie Club Apple TV channel

1626669.title: Burisch
1626669.overview: Dan Burisch recalls his time at Area 51.

1627053.title: Quando Tudo Joga Contra
1627053.overview: On the verge of failing literature, a high school soccer defender begins tutoring sessions with the quiet boy in his class—unaware that their connection will turn into something more.

1629357.title: Cornbread Mafia
1629357.overview: Cornbread Mafia is the true story of the rise and fall of Kentucky farmers who built the largest domestic marijuana syndicate in U.S. history. Part true crime, part cartoon, a whole lot of weed.

1631917.title: 18th Rose
1631917.overview: A spirited teen dreaming of the perfect debut makes a deal with a lonely newcomer, but unexpected feelings and revelations may shatter their plans.

1639341.title: Go to Sleep
1639341.overview: A recently separated man newly living alone discovers that he is sleepwalking at night, and as he records his activities, he discovers questionable behaviors and the presence of another mysterious figure.
1639341.trailerName: 'GO TO SLEEP' (2026) Official Trailer | Found Footage Sleepwalking Horror | @watchfoundtv

1641965.title: Untold: Jail Blazers
1641965.overview: Volatile players. Criminal charges. National headlines. Portland's championship-caliber NBA team implodes spectacularly in this unflinching documentary.

1647277.title: The Gardener
1647277.overview: Cosmetics heiress Sabena Weathers, battling a hostile takeover of her company, finds solace and renewal at a remote mountain cottage, where she connects with a mysterious gardener.

1658285.title: Jeffrey Epstein: The Bad Sleep Well
1658285.overview: Over the course of one troubled week, Jeffrey Epstein struggles with guilt, ambition, and growing pressure as his world of wealth and influence begins to close in on him.

1662317.title: The Crash
1662317.overview: A teen slams her car into a building, killing her boyfriend and his friend. What seems like a tragic accident becomes a murder case.

1664237.title: TEENAGERS
1664237.overview: Six old friends gather at Megan’s house for a quiet reunion while her parents are away. What begins as a casual night of music, drinks, and nostalgia quickly becomes tense as old memories resurface and the group dynamic begins to fracture. As the night goes on, an unsettling feeling takes hold, turning the familiar setting into something increasingly dangerous.

1667821.title: Kippah Power
1667821.overview: We begin in the future, where no one knows what caused “Kippah Power,” one of Israel’s greatest heroes team, to break apart. The story then travels back to the past, when the team was at the height of its greatness, following a routine mission that goes terribly wrong. Blending high-stakes action with bold, unapologetic Israeli humor, the film uncovers the truth behind their downfall-and the price each member was forced to pay.
1667821.trailerName: כוח כיפה | טריילר רשמי - Kippah Power | Official Trailer

1670061.title: Beasts Clutching at Straws
1670061.overview: Wara nimo Sugaru Kemono tachi (藁にもすがる獣たち / Beasts Clutching at Straws) is a 2026 Japanese neo-noir crime suspense thriller directed by Hideo Jojo and written by Yasuko Kobayashi. Based on Keisuke Sone's 2011 novel, the film is set for a nationwide theatrical release in Japan on September 25, 2026, distributed by Toei.  The story centers on a lost gym bag containing 100 million yen in cash found at an internet café by a struggling YouTuber living with his ailing grandmother. The discovery triggers a chaotic and violent chain reaction, entwining a corrupt police officer indebted to the Yakuza, a scheming femme fatale, and ruthless criminals all fighting to claim the fortune. The ensemble cast stars Oji Suzuka, Hiroki Narimiya, Nana Mori, MEGUMI, and Jun Fubuki.
1670061.trailerName: 『藁にもすがる獣たち』特報【9月25日(金)公開】

1670189.title: Cha Garam
1670189.overview: After completing her MBBS, Irin unexpectedly arrives at a remote, network-less tea estate in Sylhet, where healthcare depends mostly on paracetamol. Her friend Mithu, an aspiring artist and architecture student, joins her from Dhaka. There, they discover the harsh realities of tea workers’ lives and meet Nandini, a bright girl who dreams of becoming a doctor. Together, they help her chase that dream.

1676525.title: Matininó
1676525.overview: A multi-generational family of outspoken Puerto Rican women takes center stage as they conceive and perform fantastical film vignettes as a way to navigate painful pasts in this visually-arresting, kaleidoscopic documentary.

1676973.title: Iris Replica
1676973.overview: A Puzzle. Triplets are celebrating their birthday. Two are waiting for the return of the third. What they don't know is that the voice outside the door doesn't belong to their brother.

1678701.overview: Hải Vy, a 12th grade student losing faith in her passion for art, leaves her university choice blank under mounting pressure. In crisis, she falls into The Aching Echo, a surreal world of her own creation, where meeting her younger self rekindles her reason to create.
1678701.trailerName: VÙNG ĐAU ĐÁU | Short Film With Animation | OFFICIAL TEASER

1681069.title: Primary Fault
1681069.overview: Efe’s day begins, Efe’s day ends. While others lose something, everything carries on for him.

1681325.title: Starsuckers

1685613.title: The Ferry Flows
1685613.overview: A grey-haired music teacher from a small Ukrainian island turns into a military conductor at soldier funerals while trying to keep afloat his children ensemble.

1688493.title: Abuela,
1688493.overview: An intimate, investigative documentary retracing the life of Maria Jesús Echevarría. A brilliant, overlooked Spanish writer whose story was shaped by the wrong time, the wrong systems, and the right words.

1688877.title: Aterro Zeitgeist
1688877.overview: A story about a strange island and its citizens with concrete heads, and a landfill where they believed they could rid themselves of their troubles—until a small clay carranca appears. A surreal tale about how every action has consequences.

1689005.title: Boss Cat
1689005.overview: When her mother suddenly dies, Sonja is thrown into tumult. Dealing with early-twenties existential angst and a sense of responsibility for her teenage younger sister Emma, she has a lot on her plate. Suddenly under the care of her controlling grandma and—as a young woman living with Down syndrome—constantly faced with a society that judges what she’s capable of, Sonja is desperate to be herself and take charge of her own life. When a chance encounter with the charismatic Hakim leads her to a krump class, Sonja discovers a life-changing outlet for expression.

1689901.title: ¿Me entiendes o te lo explico?
1689901.overview: Madrid, Spring 1992. Pepe, owner of a Catalan tavern in Chueca, faces the worst streak of his life: his bar is in ruin, his wife leaves him and the debts drown him. When he thinks all is lost, his friends propose a twist as unexpected as brilliant: turn the tavern into a gay pub! What happens from there is an unstoppable succession of entanglements, crazy situations and endearing characters, in a politically incorrect comedy, current, and absolutely smarty.

1690221.title: ARCHAEOLOGY OF UNBORN FACES
1690221.overview: "Archaeology of Unborn Faces" is a silent cinematic excavation of the AI latent space. It stands before a digital purgatory, witnessing the agonizing struggle of algorithms trying to manifest into human form. In an epoch drowning in simulation, the film reveals that the machine creates nothing from the void, but rather recycles our abandoned memories, culminating in a terrifying emotional resonance.
1690221.trailerName: Archaeology of Unborn Faces - Official Teaser (2026)

1690285.title: Talion
1690285.overview: On their way to a remote vacation spot, a young couple witnesses a fatal hunting accident. Far from civilization and cut off from any help, they start to question the hunters' intentions.

1691245.title: Eddie Cochran: Don't Forget Me
1691245.overview: Despite his brief 21 years, Cochran’s musical legacy resonates across generations and genres, influencing icons from David Bowie to The Sex Pistols. His timeless hits like “C’mon Everybody” and “Summertime Blues” continue to shape the soundtracks of countless lives. This landmark documentary explores Cochran’s journey from country roots to rock & roll pioneer, showcasing his profound impact on music history, including his influence on legends ranging from The Beatles to Rod Stewart to Yungblud.

1691437.title: 70 ans d'Eurovision : La Grande Histoire du Concours

1693229.title: Oil
1693229.overview: A mother takes her young son to the beach in an attempt to rebuild their relationship. But what begins as a day of reconciliation shifts when a mysterious presence emerges from the sea, drawing them both into a journey of fear and mystery.

1693485.title: Inte Ett Riktigt Jobb
1693485.overview: How can an entire career in the cultural sector not count? The Minister of Education has announced that one-third of the funding for adult education associations is to be cut, with the money instead being invested in educational programs that lead to “real jobs.” What happens to the next generation of creators? And what do we lose as a society when the pathways into the cultural sector become increasingly scarce?

1693549.title: Very Deep Inside
1693549.overview: A gay couple from a small town travels to Mexico City for a weekend to celebrate one of their thirtythird birthdays. What begins as an intimate getaway soon transforms into a journey of temptation. Desire, curiosity, and discomfort push them to confront what they have avoided for years, inviting them to cross boundaries they once believed were clearly defined. In the midst of the vast metropolis, their bond begins to unravel as buried desires surface, forcing them to confront whether love can survive the weight of everything left unsaid.

1694317.title: One Guy, Too Many Dates
1694317.overview: After one too many disastrous dates, a talented software engineer creates a women-centered app where users can anonymously review their dating experiences. What begins as a simple idea quickly turns into a viral phenomenon, igniting chaos between men and women online, attracting media attention, and complicating Emily’s own love life. In a world where everyone has opinions about dating, Emily discovers that building an app about relationships might be easier than surviving one.

1695405.title: Julien Doré - Le Dernier Pestacle
1695405.overview: Filmed during the final date of his triumphant tour, Julien Doré’s concert is being shown exclusively in cinemas for a one-night-only event. A monumental show. A spectacular and immersive stage production. In a rich visual universe that is both poetic and dreamlike, blending humor and emotion, each song becomes a living tableau, alternating between grand, awe-inspiring moments and more intimate ones. Applauded by more than one million spectators, this unforgettable tour, which has become iconic, comes to a close on the big screen, offering one last moment of escape.

1697325.title: Philippe-Audrey Larrue-St-Jacques: Enfant du siècle
1697325.overview: Philippe-Audrey's solo show: his deadpan humor, sometimes scathing, and his slightly offbeat, funny dandyish appearance prove to be a unique offering that lives up to expectations.

In their attempt at finding their place in a world where nothing comes for free, the two women meet and form an unexpectedly strong bond.

1708525.title: Grindr Presents: Madonna LIVE in New York
1708525.overview: Madonna is performing LIVE! Starting off Pride Month by welcoming the community back to the dance floor, and debuting new tracks from Confessions II. The dance floor is officially open!

1716269.overview: Karla, a talented young runner diagnosed with bone cancer, receives treatment at a halfway house. There, she learns to accept reality through the support of the residents and bu Andin, while together they realize their ultimate dream.

1719917.title: Tape 001
1719917.overview: Following the discovery of a mysterious tape, a young man dives deep into the dark secrets of a mysterious video game company and the creature they made.

1720237.title: The SU
1720237.overview: For decades the Students’ Union at the University of Galway has produced some of Ireland’s leading political figures, including former President Michael D. Higgins. Over the years these young activists not only defended students’ rights, but found themselves on the front lines of battles stretching well beyond campus – from contraception to abortion, from the Troubles in Northern Ireland to war in the Middle East. Some issues have changed over time, though the overall mission remains the same. This documentary follows along as the current union executives organise protests and other events on and off campus, growing into their roles as leaders. Shot over two years, the film celebrates their passion and vitality, as well as the laughter, friendship and exuberance of youth, giving an inspiring insight into the reality of student life and the growth of strong, socially conscious leaders in whose hands the future lies.

1720301.title: Last Day

1728941.title: Pavers

1729773.title: Killer Clown
1729773.overview: Decades after witnessing her mother’s brutal murder at the hands of the “Killer Clown,” Elizabeth Helmer (Sara Paxton) remains haunted by the crime that shattered her childhood. When she begins investigating the long-unsolved cold case, Elizabeth becomes the target of a terrifying copycat stalker, forcing her to confront painful memories she has spent a lifetime trying to escape. As she searches for answers alongside her father Reed (David Cubitt) and husband Dan (Hamza Haq), Elizabeth uncovers a tangled web of family betrayal and long-buried secrets.  As she closes in on the truth, Elizabeth must separate fact from manipulation and fight to survive before history repeats itself.

1730925.title: Pocong Cantengan
1730925.overview: The search for a missing friend leads four young people to a house haunted by the Pocong Cantengan and the secret of human sacrifices ritual.

1732461.title: La saison des prix Nobel

1735981.title: The Craft
1735981.overview: Sauro Cantafame is “the techie”: he drives solo through a lunar southern landscape in his Ape Car, in a borderland between the real and the absurd. His mission? Implant mechanical hearts in deceased oldsters, so their families can pretend they’re still alive and cash their pension checks. He offers a ride to a fragile kid in danger, whose name says it all, as far as his prospects are concerned: Giocondo Infelice. But that gesture raises the hackles of Vito ‘a scimmia, the crime lord who has full control over the territory. Cantafame teaches the kid his strange trade in death, craft, and discontent; while Giocondo breaks out of his shell and finally finds the father he never had. But Cantafame has a few skeletons in his closet and a negative karma to fulfill, which will goad him to defy Vito in order to save his young charge.

1737197.title: Myrrh Meridian
1737197.overview: On Christmas Eve, Deirdre must rescue Erik from his own false realities when he treats his ventriloquist dolls as stand-ins for the parents he’s estranged from.

1737325.title: Princess Sparkles
1737325.overview: A sparkly pig teaches a reluctant adult how to grow up—just barely.

1741037.title: Family Xmas
1741037.overview: Taras Hrynchenko, a lonely elderly war veteran, decides to cut all contacts with his family for reasons unbeknownst to anyone but himself. His eight-year-old son Mirchyk accidentally comes across a pile of unopened letters that the family has been trying to send to Taras for years, yet, as they were never able to trace him, the letters never reached their intended destination. However, after a surprising mishap, the family ultimately ends up together at the Christmas table. However, things aren't as idyllic as it seems, with the many unresolved conflicts and grievances threatening to undermine an idyllic reunion.

1741229.title: Also Fine
1741229.overview: Used to keeping quiet, Wei shuts out his parents' absurd antics behind closed doors. Neglected at home, Hsuan travels north by herself and stumbles into Wei's life. Taipei's starry nights, planes piercing the sky... these overlooked everyday moments in the city turn into a ray of light for them against an ambiguous future.

1741293.title: No Recess
1741293.overview: Benny Lane won't take the pain, nor agony of his lonely/pathetic life any longer! Benny makes a drastic choice to kidnap a loner named Ford Burchett, as a means to cope with his recent breakup from his girlfriend Liz Kemper. After kidnapping Ford, Benny unintentionally sets himself on a path of chaos and madness, landing him face to face with his worst fear of all... Taking accountability!

1743597.overview: A grieving detective finds himself increasingly ensnared while investigating a case involving a sinister navigation app causing physical and psychological debris.

1750445.title: Gemini, The Apple Of My Eye!
1750445.overview: Returning to his childhood home, Kerry and his partner Gina become trapped in a surreal reality that forces long-buried family memories to resurface.

1752173.title: Out.

1755757.title: Poovellaam Kettuppaar
1755757.overview: A research project pulls Sathiya and Kartigeyan into the isolated world of Maaran and Nathiya. As the past meets the present, one conversation is all it takes to change their lives forever.
1755757.trailerName: PKP - POOVELLAAM KETTUPPAAR I OFFICIAL TRAILER - Karthik Shaamalan

1755885.overview: A chubby grade school outcast must find a way to fit into his string bean costume in time for his school's Nutrition Month performance.

What does this story reveal about Campos?

1758829.title: Magic 8
1758829.overview: 1974. A Smoke filled Sports Bar. Love is like a game of pool. “Magic 8” is a 3 minute short film shot on Super 8, which explores what happens when making a queer connection in a stereotypically “Straight” space. It follows two men (referred to as Solid and Stripe), who engage in a game of 8-Ball Pool. As an audience we get the impression this is a regular occurrence for our two characters, but there is a mutual understanding that none of Solid’s inner dialogue could ever be said out loud.

1759853.title: Fox Hunt
1759853.overview: A young man tracks down a fox that has been killing the local sheep.

1763885.title: The Mountain

The father finds himself increasingly frustrated in the midst of his impotence. The teenage daughter is forced to take responsibilities beyond her age. The mountain constricts the family’s spirit until there’s nothing left.

1764205.title: Zhalin
1764205.overview: A female university student arrives late at night at her dormitory and finds herself locked out. She is forced to make her way across the city to her aunt's house, where she encounters a mysterious man along the way.
1764205.trailerName: Zhalin | Official Trailer | A Film by Babak Davar | تریلر رسمی فیلم کوتاه ژالین، ساختۀ بابک داور

A speculative, camp mingling of the horror trope of re-animation and the heterosexual marriage plot, where Mummy, Daddy and Baby are part of a delicious and slimy circular reproductive cycle that doesn’t progress but goes around and around and around."

With the city in chaos, Zack is forced to step up and harness powers of his own.
